title: Angular Animation - behaves differently in Routed Component vs. App Component
body:
## I'm submitting a... 

[ ] Regression (a behavior that used to work and stopped working in a new release)
[x] Bug report  
[ ] Feature request
[ ] Documentation issue or request
[ ] Support request => Please do not submit support request here, instead see https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#question
## Current behavior Animation does not execute when the component is routed. In the reproduction repository you can find two examples of the same Animation that behave differently. If the component is routed the animation doesn't fire in the beginning (second list). If the animation is played in the AppComponent (first list) everything is fine. ![demo](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11500619/32090105-05df448a-baee-11e7-816a-f314adf6266b.png) Or is this wanted behavior? @matsko maybe you can say something about that. ## Expected behavior Animation behaves the same regardless of whether the component is routed or not. ## Minimal reproduction of the problem with instructions Reproduction demo: https://cankattwinkel.github.io/animation-issue/ Reproduction src: https://github.com/CanKattwinkel/animation-issue ## What is the motivation / use case for changing the behavior? - ## Environment I have tested with **5.rc6** and the most **recent version of Angular 4** (src in Repo is 4.4.6)
